_about: Output format for Agent 1 (Bill Analyst). Every field is required unless marked optional. Use null when a value is unknown. Never guess.

status.stage: one of: introduced | in_committee | reported_by_committee | passed_one_chamber | passed_both_chambers | enacted | failed

chamber_votes.method: string, e.g. 'roll call, suspension of the rules (2/3 required)'

companion_bills.title: string
companion_bills.how_found: string, e.g. 'related bills endpoint' or 'title search'

plain_summary: string, 2 to 3 sentences in plain English

provisions.type: one of: mandatory_standard | certification_requirement | ban_or_restriction | exemption_or_relief (loosens an existing rule) | labeling | reporting_requirement | tax_credit | grant_or_subsidy | tariff_or_duty | penalty | agency_rulemaking (orders an agency to write a rule) | agency_study (orders only a report or study) | other
who_must_act: one or more of: manufacturers | importers | distributors | retailers | recyclers_or_waste_handlers | other_businesses | consumers | federal_agency | states. List only who the text actually applies to.
provisions.regulator: string or null, e.g. 'Consumer Product Safety Commission'

timing.deadline_text: string, copied from the bill, or null

provisions.quote: string, exact words from the bill text that support this provision

open_questions: string, things the bill leaves unclear that affect businesses
